snippet.title: Master System Longplay [045] Sonic the Hedgehog Chaos
snippet.description:
http://www.longplays.org

Played By: T-0815

Longplay includes all 6 Chaos Emeralds. You need 100 Rings to enter a Special Stage (SS). Each of the five Special Stages includes only one Emerald. The sixth Emerald you get from the last boss.
